goal: Inquiry consent lifecycle and retention / privacy enforcement

decree_13_2023_nd_cp.article_11: Data subject right to withdraw consent unconditionally and right to request data erasure/redaction.
decree_13_2023_nd_cp.article_20: Special data protection measures requiring explicit affirmative consent before collecting personal contact data.

privacy_by_design.zero_pii_audit_trail: Audit payloads record only opaque reference identifiers, state diffs, and timestamps; personal contact values are never stored in append-only logs.

consent_tracking.validation_rules: Creation fails closed with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Content if consent.accepted is False or consent.privacy_accepted is False.

functions.name: enforce_inquiry_retention_policy
functions.signature: enforce_inquiry_retention_policy(db: Session, reference_time: Optional[datetime] = None) -> dict[str, Any]
functions.matching_criteria: retention_due_at <= reference_time OR (state == 'closed' AND retention_due_at <= reference_time)

functions.name: withdraw_inquiry_consent
functions.behavior: Instant visitor-initiated scrubbing of name, contact_value, message; privacy_accepted=False; state='closed'.

consent_withdrawal.error_handling: Returns 404 RBPC_INQUIRY_NOT_FOUND when token is invalid or missing.

public_status.behavior: Returns state='closed' with custom withdrawal message if consent was withdrawn; zero PII leakage.
